title: Admissions Standards for the Entrance Fee Agreement: Campuses, Age and Financial Thresholds
content:
Admissions office standard for the **Entrance Fee Agreement**, stating, plan by plan, where the agreement is offered and the age, financial and health screening thresholds an applicant is measured against.

## Campuses offering the agreement

Under all six refund plans, the agreement is offered only at Larkspur at Willow Creek, Larkspur at Harbor View and Larkspur at Brookfield.

## Thresholds by refund plan

| Refund plan | First resident minimum age (years) | Second resident minimum age (years) | Net worth multiple of the entrance fee | Monthly income multiple of the monthly fee | Health screening required |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LifeChoice Declining Balance Plan | 62 | 60 | 2.0 | 1.5 | No |
| LifeChoice 50% Refundable Plan | 62 | 60 | 2.0 | 1.5 | No |
| LifeChoice 75% Refundable Plan | 62 | 60 | 2.0 | 1.5 | No |
| LifeChoice 90% Refundable Plan | 62 | 60 | 2.0 | 1.5 | No |
| LifeCare Declining Balance Plan | 62 | 60 | 2.5 | 1.75 | Yes |
| LifeCare 90% Refundable Plan | 62 | 60 | 2.5 | 1.75 | Yes |

The ages are measured on the occupancy date. The net worth multiple is applied to the entrance fee of the agreement; the income multiple is applied to the independent living monthly fee.

## Validity periods (all six plans)

| Item | Validity (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Approved financial application, before signing | 90 |
| Health screening, before signing (where required) | 90 |

## Reading the table

- The two LifeCare plans set the higher financial multiples (2.5 and 1.75) and are the only plans requiring a health screening showing the applicant can live independently.
- The four LifeChoice plans share identical thresholds.
